feature.description: Setup the environment needed for the POC (dependencies, data, runtime, access permissions, compute resources and configs)

contract.purpose_user_function: Plan and gate the runtime, dependencies, data, permissions, resource constraints, commands, and write locations needed before implementation.

contract.state_side_effects: May create workspace/sprint artifacts and, once authorized, invoke environment/dependency setup through generic worker nodes.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Plan validation or dispatch fails on missing dependencies/runtime, illegal command/write scope, absent approvals, inaccessible data, or invalid configuration.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Generic governed preparation exists; no first-class cross-domain POC environment preparer or standardized environment snapshot is found.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/tools/codex_pm_router.py::_node_enrichment` and `harness/lib/plan_validator.py` accept an environment-aware task graph before dispatch.
